title: Foundations
blurb: What Christians actually believe, in six sittings — written for someone who would rather ask the question than nod along.

title: Bible Deep Dive
blurb: Not more verses — a way of reading. What the Bible is, how its two halves hold together, and how to get at a passage without a commentary.

title: Faith at Work
blurb: Most of your waking life is spent at a job, often far from home, often for someone who does not thank you. Five sessions on what God says about that.

title: Marriage & Relationships
blurb: Love described rather than felt, words that build, conflict closed the same day, and what to do when the people you love are eight hours away.
